title: Client Fee Schedule and Payer Billing Elections, Physician Client Accounts
content:
Tests client-billed under Physician Client Accounts are priced at a percentage off the test-menu list price, the client fee schedule discount of the account class. Each class also fixes which patients' tests may be client-billed at all, by the patient's payer class.

## Client fee schedule

| Account class | Client fee schedule discount (percent off the test-menu list price) | Client fee schedule reviewed every |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 45 | 12 calendar months |
| Group Practice Client Account | 50 | 12 calendar months |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 55 | 12 calendar months |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 60 | 12 calendar months |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 58 | 12 calendar months |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 50 | 12 calendar months |

## Payer billing elections

| Account class | Tests for Original Medicare Part B patients | Tests for Medicaid patients | Tests for commercially insured patients | Uninsured patients' tests under the organization's own sliding-fee program |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | May be client-billed at the organization's election | Not supported |
| Group Practice Client Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | May be client-billed at the organization's election | Not supported |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | May be client-billed at the organization's election | Not supported |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | May be client-billed at the organization's election | Supported: the organization client-bills these tests under its own sliding-fee program |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | May be client-billed at the organization's election | Not supported |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | Never client-billed | Never client-billed | Not client-billed | Not supported |

## Notes on the schedule

- The discount is a percentage taken off the test-menu list price; the organization is client-billed the remainder. A class with a 60 percent discount is billed 40 percent of list.
- The client fee schedule of every class is reviewed every 12 calendar months.
- In no class may tests for Original Medicare Part B patients or for Medicaid patients ever be client-billed.
- Commercially insured patients' tests can be client-billed, at the organization's election, in every class except the Occupational Health Employer Account.
- Only the Federally Qualified Health Center Account supports client billing of uninsured patients' tests under the organization's own sliding-fee program.

## Illustration: one test across the classes (hypothetical list price of USD 120.00)

| Account class | Discount | Share of list billed | Client price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 45 percent | 55 percent | USD 66.00 |
| Group Practice Client Account | 50 percent | 50 percent | USD 60.00 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 55 percent | 45 percent | USD 54.00 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 60 percent | 40 percent | USD 48.00 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 58 percent | 42 percent | USD 50.40 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 50 percent | 50 percent | USD 60.00 |
